english.title: Fail to ensure worker provided with information re: regulated and reportable substances
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having carried on a trade, business or profession involving the supply of

(A)_[regulated]_
(B)_[reportable]_

substances, and engaged a worker, namely **(..SPECIFY WORKER..), in connection with making such supplies, failed to ensure that the worker was not involved in the making of supplies of such substances before first being provided with such information on the requirements that were imposed by the Poisons Act 1972, by the Control of Explosives Precursors and Poisons Regulations 2023, and by the Control of Poisons and Explosives Precursors Regulations 2015 in relation to the supply of regulated substances and reportable substances, the offences that applied in respect of a failure to comply with those requirements and the

(C)_[regulated]_
(D)_[reportable]_

substances that you supplied as was relevant to the worker’s role and responsibilities
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 4 of the Control of Explosives Precursors and Poisons Regulations 2023 and sections 7(4) and 8(5) of the Poisons Act 1972.

other.penalty:
Summary: a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

In the case of a continuing offence, a further fine not exceeding one-tenth of level 4 on the standard scale for every day subsequent to the day on which the person is convicted of the offence during which the contravention or default continues.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Proceedings may be commenced at any time -
(a) within the period of 12 months next after the date of commission of the offence, or
(b) in the case of proceedings instituted by, or by the direction of, the Secretary of State, within the later to end of -
(i) that 12-month period, and (ii) the period of 3 months next after the date on which evidence sufficient in the Secretary of State's opinion to justify a prosecution for the offence comes to the Secretary of State's knowledge.
